hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"; f=$(sed -n 's/.*"file_path": *"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -1); [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; case "$f" in *.py|*.pyi) uv run ruff check --fix -q "$f" > /dev/null; uv run ruff format -q "$f"; uv run ruff check -q "$f" >&2 || exit 2;; *) [ -f biome.json ] && { bunx biome check --write --no-errors-on-unmatched --files-ignore-unknown=true --colors=off "$f" >&2 || exit 2; };; esac; exit 0
